text:
maria_sec: Auditor requested end-to-end proof for the recent RBAC change affecting inference-service plus KMS decrypts tied to API calls. They want a compact sample (10 users) with approval artifacts, deploy hashes, k8s audit snippets, KMS logs, and the API trace chain. Deadline EOD.

auditor_jane: Confirming scope: production only, last 30 days, and raw JSON snippets preferred. Also want a manifest with checksums and a short mapping to SOC2/ISO control IDs.

maria_sec: correct. We should also include who signed off (approvers) and a statement of sanitization for PII.

tom_infra: I can pull kubectl audit logs + Git changelist for the RoleBinding updates. Will export diffs and include PR/CHG references. Need sample user list.

sam_sre: KMS decrypt events come from cloud KMS audit logs. Suggested search in our ELK: 
```
#index=prod_kms action=Decrypt earliest=-30d@d | fields user,keyName,requestId,timestamp | sort -timestamp desc | head 500
```
That returns requestId values we can correlate with http logs.

kevin_devexp: reminder: keep examples small. Auditor prefers 2 full end-to-end traces + 8 supporting snippets. We'll compress bundle and include README.

olivia_prod: I'll assemble the 10-user sample (cross-team) and note any users that were part of the change window. Two users were in the canary on 2025-11-14. Sending list to the ticket.

maria_sec: Tom 1: please include the JIRA change record, the approval email (scrubbed), and the deploy manifest hash. Also add the canary window notes.

tom_infra: Added: CHG-1420 (change ticket), PR-4580 (linked), deploy SHA: a3f4c6d. Including k8s audit snippet (sanitized): 
```
{"verb":"update","resource":"rolebindings","user":"deploy-bot","objectRef":{"name":"inference-readers"},"requestURI":"/api/v1/namespaces/default/rolebindings/inference-readers","timestamp":"2025-11-14T15:22:58Z"}
```

sam_sre: pasted sample KMS entries (sanitized): 
```
user: olivia@redwood.com key: projects/p1/locations/global/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/inference-key action: Decrypt request_id: req-7f1d ts:2025-11-14T15:23:03Z
user: carol@redwood.com key: ... request_id: req-8b2a ts:2025-11-20T09:11:44Z
user: dave@redwood.com key: ... request_id: req-2c3e ts:2025-11-21T18:02:10Z
```

auditor_jane: For each request_id we need the API request that consumed the decrypted secret (x-rw-request-id header) so we can see the full chain. Two full examples are fine.

sam_sre: Correlation query for http logs: 
```
#index=prod_http x-rw-request-id=REQID | table timestamp, client_ip, path, status, request_id, user_email
```
I'll attach two full traces (sanitized) as JSON in the bundle and link them in the README.

olivia_prod: Note: mitigation for sidecar privilege problem is in TICKET-667 (vuln triage). We replaced cluster-admin binding with a narrow Role and rolled a follow-up CR. There was a brief error spike (~3m) during the canary. Link: INC-2025-349.

maria_sec: Good to include that vuln-triage timeline as context. Auditor often asks for evidence of risk acceptance and remediations.

sam_sre: Also exporting Key metadata: rotation schedule, primary key version, and IAM policy. Command we'll include: 
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy inference-key --location=global --keyring=inference-ring --format=json
```
And a policy snippet: 
```
{"bindings":[{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter","members":["user:service-account@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}]}
```

kevin_devexp: Auditor requested checksums. We'll produce MD5 + SHA256 for each file and a signed manifest. Security team can sign with our PGP key: fingerprint 0xC0FFEE12.

maria_sec: security-bot: please create evidence bundle and calculate checksums.

security-bot: Automated: creating evidence bundle. bundle-id=bndl-20251115-11. Encrypting with auditor's public key, generating manifest (md5+sha256) and GPG signature. Uploading to s3.

security-bot: Automated: bundle uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251115-11.zip.gpg, manifest: s3://redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251115-11-manifest.txt, signature: s3://redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251115-11-manifest.sig

auditor_jane: thanks 1: can you share presigned link and confirm manifest includes mapping to SOC2 CC6 and ISO A.9 controls? Also need a short MD or PDF tying each sample snippet to control statements.

maria_sec: we'll attach mapping doc (MD) and confirm control crosswalk. Presigned links are on the ticket now and I sent the bundle to the auditor's SFTP as well.

security-bot: Automated: manifest summary (excerpt):
```
file: CHG-1420.json md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...
file: kms-snippets.json md5: 5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592 sha256: 2c26b46b68ffc68ff99b453c1d304134...
file: http-trace-01.json md5: 7b52009b64fd0a2a...
```

maria_sec: bundle presigned (7d): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251115-11.zip.gpg?X-Amz-Expires=604800

auditor_jane: Received the link and manifest. I'll validate signatures and check the mapping doc first thing. Thanks for quick turnaround.

maria_sec: thanks all 1: closing once auditor confirms.

security-bot: Automated: evidence bundle bndl-20251115-11 integrity verified and signature valid.

auditor_jane: Confirmed signature and checksums. One minor follow-up: can you provide the GKE control plane audit export timeframe (we need 30-day retention proof). I'll open a follow-up if needed.

maria_sec: noted. Filing follow-up and will add export policy proof. Thanks.
